failure.name: ASSIGNED_BUT_NEVER_REACHED_LOCK_RANGE (LA-F1)
failure.description: assigned USV never enters lock range; baseline per-assignment lock rate 71.6%; LA-F1 = 70.7% of no-lock (6/6 strategies)

root_cause.name: PRE_LOCK_STANDOFF (hypothesis)
root_cause.description: initial hypothesis: pre-lock standoff band prevented sufficient closing

mechanism.name: LOCK_FIRST_APPROACH
mechanism.summary: before the first lock of the current target, always close toward the target's predicted position instead of holding the standoff band
mechanism.trigger_condition: USV has an assigned target it has not yet locked
mechanism.behavior_change: pre-lock move action replaced by aggressive closure; post-lock behaviour unchanged

required_conditions: assigned target with a predicted position

limitations: lock-rate gain partly from a smaller assignment denominator (S1 158->91)
TTFL did not improve; combat was mixed
lessons: 'never reached lock range' does NOT imply 'simply close more aggressively'
LA-F1 is a symptom; the dominant subcause is LA1-E (USV dies before closure, 48.2%), not lack of closing
next_questions: is the real limiter survival (USV dies while chasing a far/lost target) or track loss?
